WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipment_reference,
         AVG(se.humepct) AS average_humidity
  FROM equipment AS e
  LEFT JOIN scanenvironment AS se
    ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry
  GROUP BY e.equipregistry
),
reference_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS all_equipment_average
  FROM equipment_averages
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT ea.equipment_reference,
         ea.average_humidity,
         ea.average_humidity - ra.all_equipment_average AS excess_humidity
  FROM equipment_averages AS ea
  CROSS JOIN reference_averages AS ra
  WHERE ea.average_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.all_equipment_average IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.average_humidity > ra.all_equipment_average
),
with_group_mean AS (
  SELECT aa.*,
         AVG(aa.average_humidity) OVER () AS above_average_group_mean
  FROM above_average AS aa
)
SELECT equipment_reference,
       average_humidity,
       excess_humidity,
       average_humidity - above_average_group_mean AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM with_group_mean
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
